row.evidence: Yodeck's SCIM guides say 'To enable SCIM in the Yodeck app, you first have to successfully enable SSO', and the pricing page lists 'SAML SSO & Data encryption' only on Enterprise ($16/screen/month, billed annually).
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Priced per screen, treated as per-user for normalisation; all plans have unlimited users. Enterprise rose from $15 to $16/screen/mo (annual) since June; Basic unchanged at $8; Premium $12. The pricing page does not name SCIM: the Enterprise gate comes from SCIM requiring SAML SSO, which is Enterprise-only, so confidence is medium. SCIM ('Deprovision using SCIM') is set up through generic IdP SCIM apps (Okta SCIM 2.0 Test App, Entra custom app, OneLogin SCIM Provisioner); catalogue apps in Okta and Entra are SSO only. generic is true: Yodeck issues a token and identifier URL for any SCIM 2.0 client, though the URL itself is not published. The REST API (Beta) with user, role, group endpoints and user webhooks starts at Premium, so api_tax is true.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SCIM not named on the pricing page; it requires SAML SSO, which is Enterprise-only. Audit logs are a portal app, not an API.

auth.token_source: Account settings > SSO (Single Sign On) > Advanced Settings > Deprovision using SCIM > generate secret token

limitations.text: SSO must be enabled first and SCIM must be set up by the Account Owner.
No Yodeck-specific catalogue app provisions; setup uses generic SCIM apps (Okta SCIM 2.0 Test App, Entra custom app, OneLogin SCIM Provisioner).
Docs describe provisioning and deletion only; attribute updates, deactivation and groups are not documented.

scim.notes: Version 2.0 inferred from the IdP apps Yodeck tells customers to use (Okta 'SCIM 2.0 Test App', OneLogin 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)'). The base URL ('identifier URL') is shown in SSO settings and is not published. Plan is inferred: SCIM requires SSO, and SAML SSO is Enterprise-only on the pricing page.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Logs is a portal application (Enterprise on the pricing page); no audit-log endpoint seen in the API bundle.

rate_limits.text: Per token and per account, three levels: Low 14/42, Standard 21/63, High 33/99 requests per 10s (token/account); 429 when exceeded. User endpoints are Standard.

user_api.notes: API is labelled Beta. Pricing page lists 'Yodeck AI Agent & API' from Premium; Basic (team plan) has no API.

okta.notes: OIN Yodeck app ticks SAML and SWA only; Yodeck's SCIM guide uses Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO with manual provisioning; Yodeck's SCIM guide uses a custom non-gallery Entra app.

onelogin.notes: Yodeck's guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app; a Yodeck catalogue app was not checked.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, supported endpoints, PATCH/PUT, attribute list, groups and filtering are not documented publicly.
Whether SCIM deletion frees a seat is moot (per-screen pricing, unlimited users); whether user content is retained after SCIM delete is not documented.
Pricing page never names SCIM; the Enterprise gate is inferred from SCIM requiring SAML SSO.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue listings not checked.
Whether JIT user creation on SAML sign-in exists is not documented (Entra tutorial says provisioning is manual).
